canonical_project: Jecheon Internet Data Center, 4th Industrial Complex
owner: Welcome Asset Management consortium; Jecheon-si; Chungcheongbuk-do
notes: Jecheon and Chungcheongbuk-do signed an MOU for a data center in the planned 4th Industrial Complex on about 33,000 sq m. Local reports cite 40 MW and roughly KRW 600 billion investment.
